Incoterms 2020

アウトターン報告書

An official document recording the quantity and condition of goods discharged from a vessel or container at the port of arrival, used for claims, insurance, and operational performance tracking.

Questions and answers

What is アウトターン報告書?

In this glossary, アウトターン報告書 refers to: An official document recording the quantity and condition of goods discharged from a vessel or container at the port of arrival, used for claims, insurance, and operational performance tracking.

How is アウトターン報告書 used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "アウトターン報告書で仕向港での荷下ろし貨物に不足と損傷が判明した。"

Why does アウトターン報告書 matter in logistics?

アウトターン報告書 matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses アウトターン報告書?

アウトターン報告書 is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official document recording the quantity and condition of goods discharged from a vessel or container at the port of arrival, used for claims, insurance, and operational performance tracking.

Operational example

The outturn report revealed a shortage and some damage in the discharged cargo at the destination port.
